name: Enamine_search_catalog
description: Search Enamine compound catalog by keyword or name when the Enamine Store API is available. The tool returns an explicit error rather than a successful empty result when the upstream endpoint is unavailable. JSON payloads support local limit/offset pagination, with metadata warning that upstream global completeness is undocumented.

query.description: Search query - compound name or keyword

catalog.description: Catalog: REAL (make-on-demand), BB (building blocks), SCR (screening), all (default: all)

limit.description: Maximum records from the returned API payload.

offset.description: Zero-based offset within the returned API payload.

name: Enamine_get_compound
description: Get compound details by Enamine ID when the Enamine Store API is available. If upstream retrieval fails, returns an explicit error and never substitutes a guessed web URL for compound data.

name: Enamine_search_smiles
description: Search Enamine by chemical structure (SMILES) when the Enamine Store API is available. Returns an explicit error rather than a successful empty result when upstream is unavailable. JSON payloads support local limit/offset pagination with unknown upstream completeness.

smiles.description: SMILES string for the query compound

search_type.description: Search type: exact, substructure, similarity (default: similarity)

limit.description: Maximum records from the returned API payload.

offset.description: Zero-based offset within the returned API payload.

name: Enamine_get_libraries
description: Retrieve the live Enamine library catalog when its Store API is available. If upstream is unavailable, returns an explicit error rather than presenting hard-coded marketing copy as retrieved data.
